title: Grill — collapse / expand the task messages backlog (round 2)
summary: One contradiction to settle before the record is written. You chose **session-only** collapse state, but also confirmed that a collapsed tray should still be collapsed after its last draft is sent or deleted. Those two cannot both hold with the state inside `BacklogTray`: the tray is only rendered while it has items, so an empty backlog unmounts it and destroys its `useState`. The next saved draft remounts it expanded. Pick which behavior wins.

questions.title: When the last draft is removed and a later draft is saved, should the tray stay collapsed or reopen expanded?
questions.why: This decides whether the collapse flag stays inside `BacklogTray` or is lifted to `RunPanelBody`, and whether the accepted lifecycle line is amended.
questions.context: Round 1, persistence: you chose **“Not persisted — session only”** (the option said the state resets on task switch, subagent tab, panel close and restart). Round 1, lifecycle: you confirmed **“after the last draft is sent or deleted, a later draft follows the stored choice (collapsed if you last collapsed)”**. With the flag inside `BacklogTray`, that second part cannot hold: `RunPanel.tsx:4583` renders the tray only while `backlogItems.length > 0`, so removing the last draft unmounts the tray and its `useState`; the next draft remounts it at the default. There is no stored choice to follow.

evidence.label: the local flag would die with it

options.label: Accept the reset — the next draft opens expanded
options.description: Keep the flag in `BacklogTray` and amend the lifecycle answer: an empty tray forgets the state, and the next saved draft appears expanded.
options.consequence: Fully consistent with session-only and the current render gate; no parent prop, no reset line. The one surprise is a collapsed-then-emptied task reopening expanded — arguably good, because it shows the draft you just saved.

options.label: Keep it session-only, but hold the flag in `RunPanelBody`
options.description: The parent already survives empty→non-empty and subagent-tab switches; reset the flag on task id in the existing `[task.id]` effect.
options.consequence: Survives the empty gap and subagent tabs within the same panel session; still resets on task switch (explicit reset) and on panel close/restart. Adds one prop and a reset line, and departs from the round-1 option's “resets on subagent tab” description.

options.label: Switch to the global localStorage flag you overrode
options.description: `agetor:backlogTrayCollapsed`, one choice for every task and every restart.
options.consequence: Survives empty, task switch, subagent tab and restart with no parent state; reverses the round-1 persistence answer and adds a `panel-collapse.ts` key plus `CLAUDE.md:175`.

options.label: Switch to per-task localStorage
options.description: The key includes the task id, so a task remembers its own state forever.
options.consequence: Survives everything for that task; unbounded keys, a cleanup story, and a key-builder helper.

recommendation.reason: It is the only option that keeps your explicit session-only choice and the current render gate without adding parent state; the reset is an obscure edge and it re-shows the draft you just saved.
